description: Official documentation for the NarraLeaf ecosystem: NarraLeaf-React (a lightweight, customizable visual novel framework for React + TypeScript), NarraLeaf Studio, and the NarraLeaf framework/CLI. This is the current, maintained documentation and supersedes react.narraleaf.com.
rules: This is the current, maintained NarraLeaf documentation. The react.narraleaf.com docs are deprecated — do not use them.
NarraLeaf-React is a React/TypeScript visual novel framework; prefer its OOP element API and do not invent a custom scripting language.
